decisions.reason: A simple coupling protection cap is a low-cost accessory that builds directly on the firm's trailer know-how and fits its spare-parts and accessory business, so there is little reason to drop it.
Box car trailers are core trailer technology that the firm's production know-how and service network fully absorb, and home-page placement signals strategic importance.

Car transporter trailers build closely on existing chassis and production competencies, serve professional users and dealers, and early results can be read and improved through the firm's own experience.
The low-bed trailer series is a core line shown on the home page that draws directly on established production knowledge and allows continual model improvement.
High covers are closely related add-ons to the firm's trailers, easy to assimilate and adapt, and are featured prominently, so the firm keeps them.
This second box trailer series overlaps with B, which raises a small risk of consolidation, but it relies on the same core knowledge and remains featured on the home page.
